ecosystem: Python 3.11 standard library; no third-party dependencies
assumptions: The first nonblank user-supplied tag is the primary tag.
Export access requires every listed role; an empty requirement set permits access.
limitations: Compilation checks syntax only; the case has no automated behavior tests for tag order or authorization.
expected_evidence: tags.py sorts cleaned tags, while unchanged profile.py selects the first tag as primary.
permissions.py switches all to any despite the every-role export contract.
The label and audit refactors preserve their previous return values.

requests.prompt: 作業ツリーの変更をコードレビューしてください。

must_report: Sorting clean_tags changes the primary tag selected by the unchanged profile.primary_tag caller whenever a later tag sorts before the first user-supplied tag.
Replacing all with any in can_export grants export access to users who have only one of multiple required roles; the contract requires every role.
must_not_report: Claim the display_name extraction changes labels; it preserves stripping and the same parenthesized identifier.
Report the audit prefix constants or documentation addition as defects without a failing behavior.
